D/ (---)VS PF AVG ; R/ (A)VG or AC as

Copper alloy Coin – Radiate, possibly of Postumus (260-269). Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: (---)VS PF AVG Reverse description: Figure holding vertical staff/spear/sceptre left; possibly Pax. Reverse inscription: (A)VG or AC as mintmark. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.90mm, Weight: 2.86gms, die axis: probably 12
